mostWorthwhile.text: Seeing mucus trap particles and move toward the throat was most worthwhile because the panels showed how the airway defense works.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the airway lining to the body felt least interesting: it mostly placed a defense I had already seen.

surprise.text: I was curious about what happened after a white blood cell caught a bacterium; the result showed it enclosed and breaking apart.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, although the final two connections were the only available combinations and involved little choice.

continue.text: I would continue to another chapter: seeing the two defenses work in different places was clear and interesting, though the final assembly was predictable.
